Anatomic Site:Brain tumor biopsy
Tumor margin assessment
Clinical Diagnosis/History:
The patient is a 12-year-old boy with a history of a supratentorial ependymoma, who presents for evaluation due to new onset seizures.
Gross Description:
The specimen is received fresh in two parts, labeled with the patient's name and medical record number.
Part A is labeled "brain tumor biopsy," consisting of three unoriented, gray-white soft tissue fragments measuring 1.0 x 0.8 x 0.5 cm in aggregate. A portion is frozen for frozen section diagnosis 1, and another portion is taken for cytologic preparation. The remainder is submitted in cassette A1.
Part B is labeled "tumor margin," consisting of two pale-pink, soft tissue fragments measuring 0.7 x 0.5 x 0.2 cm in aggregate. The entire specimen is submitted in cassette B1.
Diagnosis Comments:
Immunohistochemical analysis was performed using GFAP and EMA antibodies, confirming the diagnosis of a WHO Grade II Ependymoma. A formal GFAP labeling index will be provided in an addendum.
Interoperative Diagnosis:
FS1 (A) Brain, supratentorial region, biopsy: Ependymoma, consistent with recurrence. Tissue section and cytologic preparation.
Final Diagnosis:
A. Brain, biopsy: Ependymoma, WHO Grade II; see comment.
B. Brain, "tumor margin," excision: Fragments of brain parenchyma; no tumor identified.

RESULTED BY
Addendum Comment:
The GFAP immunohistochemical labeling index is approximately 3.8%.

Anatomic Site:Spinal cord tumor biopsy
Spinal tumor
Clinical Diagnosis/History:
The patient is a 45-year-old woman with progressive lower extremity weakness, found to have a thoracic intradural tumor.
Gross Description:
The specimen is received fresh in two parts, labeled with the patient's name and medical record number.
Part A is labeled "spinal cord tumor biopsy," consisting of a single, unoriented, irregularly shaped, white-tan fragment of soft tissue measuring 0.4 x 0.3 x 0.2 cm. A portion is frozen for frozen section diagnosis 1, with the remaining specimen submitted in cassette A1.
Part B is labeled "spinal tumor," consisting of one, soft, pink-red tissue fragment measuring 5 x 2.5 x 1.5 cm. The specimen reveals soft pink-red parenchyma with areas of gross microvascular proliferation and measures 1.2 x 0.8 x 0.5 cm. The entire proliferative area is submitted in cassettes B1-B2, with representative sections in cassette B3.
Diagnosis Comments:
Histological examination shows moderate cellularity with oval nuclei, and rare mitotic figures. Microvascular proliferation is noted.
Interoperative Diagnosis:
FS1 (A) Spinal tumor, biopsy: Ependymoma, WHO grade II. Tissue section and cytologic preparation.
Final Diagnosis:
A. Thoracic spinal cord, biopsy: Ependymoma, WHO grade II, see comment.
B. Thoracic spinal cord, biopsy: Ependymoma, WHO grade II, see comment.
++++++++++Addendum++++++++++
RESULTED BY
Addendum Comment:
The MIB-1 labeling index is approximately 5.5%, consistent with moderate proliferative activity.

Anatomic Site:Posterior fossa tumor biopsy
Tumor margin analysis
Clinical Diagnosis/History:
The patient is a 22-year-old man with headache and dizziness, found to have a posterior fossa lesion suspected to be an ependymoma.
Gross Description:
The specimen is received fresh in two parts, labeled with the patient's name and medical record number.
Part A is labeled "posterior fossa tumor biopsy," consisting of four unoriented, gray-tan soft tissue fragments measuring 1.5 x 1.0 x 0.5 cm in aggregate. A portion is frozen for frozen section diagnosis 1, with the remainder submitted in cassette A1.
Part B is labeled "tumor margin," consisting of three soft, pink-tan tissue fragments measuring 0.9 x 0.4 x 0.3 cm in aggregate. The entire specimen is submitted in cassette B1.
Diagnosis Comments:
Immunohistochemical analysis using Synaptophysin and Vimentin antibodies supports the diagnosis of WHO Grade III Ependymoma. A formal Synaptophysin labeling index will be performed and reported in an addendum.
Interoperative Diagnosis:
FS1 (A) Brain, posterior fossa, biopsy: Ependymoma, WHO grade III. Tissue section and cytologic preparation.
Final Diagnosis:
A. Posterior fossa, biopsy: Ependymoma, WHO Grade III; see comment.
B. Posterior fossa, "tumor margin," excision: Fragments of brain parenchyma; no tumor identified.
++++++++++Addendum++++++++++
RESULTED BY
Addendum Comment:
The Synaptophysin immunohistochemical labeling index is 6.2%, indicating increased proliferative activity.
